guide.summary: Public app, your own Harvest ID OAuth2 app (approval path unconfirmed). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.

composio.note: Composio lists Harvest as managed OAuth, so prototypes can use it. Switch to your own app for branding and dedicated quota.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio's managed Harvest app works. For production, use your own app so users see your name, and so you get dedicated quota and your own scope choices.
reasons: Consent screen shows your app name, not Composio's
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of shared quota
Control over scopes beyond Composio's defaults

scenarios.label: Public app, your own Harvest ID OAuth2 app
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects many end users' Harvest accounts through an OAuth2 app you create yourself.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

scenarios.approval: No provider review or approval is described in the docs; this is unconfirmed beyond the docs reviewed.

prerequisites.title: Harvest ID account
prerequisites.detail: You need a Harvest ID login to reach the Developers section where OAuth2 apps are created.

prerequisites.title: Composio redirect URI
prerequisites.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and use it as the app's Redirect URL.

steps.title: Create OAuth2 app in Harvest ID
steps.detail: Log in to Harvest ID and create an application in the Developers section. Enter a name, redirect URL, multi-account setting and products.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Choose minimal product scope
steps.detail: Decide whether the app needs Harvest, Forecast or both. The docs advise the minimal scope.
inputs: List of features your agent uses
steps.done_when: Products setting matches the features used.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Harvest auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Check that the redirect URI matches the one registered.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and uses your credentials.

steps.title: Connect a test account
steps.detail: Authorize a Harvest account through Composio's connect flow and run one tool call.
steps.done_when: A connected account is created and a call succeeds.

traps.title: Old V1 registration page is deprecated
traps.detail: The page mentioning harvestapp.com/oauth2/clients is for the deprecated V1 API. Use Harvest ID's Developers section for V2.

traps.title: Greenhouse 'Harvest API' is a different product
traps.detail: Search results about partner agreements and monthly reviews describe Greenhouse's Harvest API, not Harvest time tracking. Ignore them for this app.

traps.title: Missing User-Agent header causes 400 errors
traps.detail: Every API request needs a User-Agent header naming the app and a link or email. Requests without it get 400 Bad Request.

traps.title: Redirect URI must start with the registered URL
traps.detail: A redirect_uri passed at authorization must begin with the Redirect URL registered on the app.

traps.title: Personal access tokens are not for other users
traps.detail: A personal access token is tied to you. Use the OAuth2 flow to let other people use your integration.

open_questions: Does Harvest ever review or limit OAuth apps used by outside customers? Check by creating an app in Harvest ID and contacting Harvest support.
Is a Harvest integration listing required or optional? The listing form was found, but nothing says it gates OAuth use; ask Harvest via the integration submission page.
Are there rate limits or app-count limits for OAuth apps? Not found; check the Harvest API V2 docs on rate limits.
Does a customer's Harvest admin need to approve third-party apps? Docs show none; test with a non-admin account.
Not found: limits before approval. Checked getharvest.com, getharvest.com.

items.reason: Quote states OAuth2 flow allows other people to use integrations; the PAT 'tied to you' contrast is implied by c20's quote, and this quote's main claim matches.
The URL quote shows only client_id and response_type parameters, but the quotes do not describe the absence of review, verification, or listing requirements; that part is unsupported.
Quote says the URL lets the user authenticate on Harvest ID and authorize access to their account(s).
Quote confirms the app is created from the Developers section, but says nothing about dynamic client registration either way.
Quote states scope can be Harvest, Forecast or both and advises picking the minimal scope.
Quote states each request must include a User-Agent header with both required items (the quote is cut off before listing them, but the requirement itself is stated).
Quote states that omitting the User-Agent header yields a 400 Bad Request response.
Quote states a Personal Access Token is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start using the API.

Quotes show other people can use the integration via the authorize URL and the app is created in Developers, but nothing states that no provider review is needed; the no-review claim is unsupported and the rest is only partly covered.
Quotes support creating the app in Developers and sharing the authorize URL, and mention settings/scopes, but do not state the ordering or that the redirect URL step is a required gate.
Quotes describe the app creation and authorize flow but say nothing about time to create (under an hour) or the absence of provider review; the claim's specifics are not addressed.
